skill.name: tests-maintenance
skill.description: Maintains IdeaVim test quality by reviewing disabled tests, documenting Neovim exclusions, and improving test readability.
skill.summary: Maintain IdeaVim tests with focused, documented, and reviewable changes.
skill.author: JetBrains

security_audit.summary: The static findings are false positives from Markdown backticks, fenced examples, and literal annotation names in SKILL.md. The skill describes focused IdeaVim test-maintenance workflows using local search and Gradle test commands, with no prompt injection, credential handling, network calls, or data exfiltration intent found.

content.value_statement: IdeaVim test suites can accumulate disabled tests, vague Neovim exclusions, and unclear sample text. This skill guides focused maintenance that keeps changes small, documented, and reviewable.
actual_capabilities: Selects a small IdeaVim test area for one focused maintenance pass.
Finds disabled Kotlin tests and checks whether documented reasons remain valid.
Reviews @TestWithoutNeovim annotations for specific reasons and required descriptions.
Improves test readability by replacing meaningless placeholder text.
Prepares concise pull request titles and summaries for test-only changes.
limitations: It assumes the IdeaVim repository layout and Kotlin test conventions.
It does not fix production code bugs or implement missing features.
Gradle and Neovim test checks still depend on the local developer environment.
Human review is needed before removing tests or changing skip semantics.

use_cases.title: Re-enable Passing Tests
use_cases.description: Review one @Disabled test, run the focused test, and document why it can be restored.

use_cases.title: Clarify Neovim Exclusions
use_cases.description: Replace vague @TestWithoutNeovim reasons with specific categories and clear descriptions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Focused Maintenance PRs
use_cases.description: Run a small test-quality sweep and produce a reviewable pull request summary.

prompt_templates.title: Review One Disabled Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Review one disabled IdeaVim test. Run the smallest relevant test command. If it passes, propose a focused re-enable change with a short PR summary.

prompt_templates.title: Document Neovim Skip Reasons
prompt_templates.prompt: Find @TestWithoutNeovim usages in one test class. Add missing descriptions only when the same reason and fix pattern apply.

prompt_templates.title: Replace Deprecated Reasons
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect one test that uses DIFFERENT or UNCLEAR. Verify Neovim testing is active. Analyze the failure and propose a specific replacement reason.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Maintenance Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose one logical test-maintenance change in IdeaVim. Keep the scope narrow, explain evidence, and draft the title and body.

output_examples.input: A disabled test now passes locally after a focused run.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: re-enable the test, cite the local pass result, and explain the likely upstream fix in the pull request body.

output_examples.input: A Neovim exclusion uses a vague reason with no description.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: replace the vague reason with the closest specific category and add a short description of the observed behavior difference.

output_examples.input: A test uses meaningless placeholder text.
output_examples.output: Recommendation: replace the placeholder with realistic sample text that still exercises the same editing behavior.

best_practices: Work on one test method or one closely related group per run.
Confirm Neovim verification is active before changing Neovim exclusion annotations.
Keep pull request summaries tied to observed test behavior.
anti_patterns: Do not combine annotation cleanup, content rewrites, and test re-enablement in one change.
Do not assign intentional-difference reasons without evidence from comments, history, or platform behavior.
Do not change production code while performing test maintenance.

faq.question: What repository does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets the IdeaVim repository and its Kotlin test suite.

faq.question: Can it fix failing production behavior?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on test maintenance and documentation, not product bug fixes.

faq.question: Does it run the whole test suite?
faq.answer: It prefers the smallest focused Gradle test command for the selected method or class.

faq.question: How does it handle Neovim exclusions?
faq.answer: It checks whether each exclusion has a specific reason and a clear description.

faq.question: Can it remove disabled tests?
faq.answer: It may suggest removal only when the test covers obsolete behavior.

faq.question: Who should review the changes?
faq.answer: An IdeaVim maintainer should review annotation changes, test removals, and re-enabled tests.
